Surrogate models for uncertainty quantification: An overview

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Direct Read now none UQ Review
Bruno Sudret, Stefano Marelli, Joe Wiart 2017-03-01 10.23919/eucap.2017.7928679
单位: Dpt. of Civil, Environmental and Geomatic Engineering, Switzerland
通讯: Bruno Sudret @ Dpt. of Civil, Environmental and Geomatic Engineering, Switzerland
相关性: 该论文系统综述了用于不确定性量化的代理模型方法，直接解决了昂贵仿真采样效率问题，并涵盖了约束处理（如概率失效）和不确定性量化，方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计。
边界: This paper is a review and does not present a novel method or application to implant/biomechanics design.
动机· 计算机模型日益复杂，输入参数不确定性导致蒙特卡洛模拟成本过高。
方法· 综述了多项式混沌展开和低秩张量近似等代理模型方法。
结果· 代理模型可高效估计统计量、灵敏度指标和失效概率。
验证· 无实验验证，为理论综述。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The increasing complexity of computer models and limited knowledge of input parameters make Monte Carlo simulation computationally prohibitive.
Method· This review presents surrogate modeling techniques including polynomial chaos expansions and low-rank tensor approximations to propagate uncertainties.
Result· Surrogate models enable efficient estimation of statistical moments, sensitivity indices, and probabilities of failure.
Validation· No experimental validation; this is a theoretical review.
surrogate model · 代理模型uncertainty quantification · 不确定性量化polynomial chaos expansion · 多项式混沌展开low-rank tensor approximation · 低秩张量近似Monte Carlo simulation · 蒙特卡洛模拟sensitivity analysis · 灵敏度分析probability of failure · 失效概率
surrogate model uncertainty quantification polynomial chaos expansion low-rank tensor approximation review

Bayesian Optimization with Gradients

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Jian Wu, Matthias Poloczek, Andrew Gordon Wilson, Peter I. Frazier Neural Information Processing Systems 2017-03-01 link
单位: cornell University
通讯: Jian Wu @ cornell University
相关性: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化方法利用梯度信息提高采样效率，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的昂贵仿真优化问题。
边界: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond acquisition function, or implant/biomechanics design context.
动机· 贝叶斯优化通常不使用导数信息，导致采样效率低。
方法· 提出导数增强的知识梯度算法dKG，利用噪声和不完全的导数信息。
结果· 在多个基准测试中，dKG优于无梯度和有梯度的优化方法。
验证· 在逻辑回归、深度学习等数值基准上验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Bayesian optimization typically ignores derivative information, limiting its sampling efficiency for expensive multimodal objectives.
Method· We propose the derivative-enabled knowledge-gradient (dKG) algorithm that incorporates noisy and incomplete gradient information in both sequential and batch settings.
Result· dKG achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks including logistic regression, deep learning, kernel learning, and k-nearest neighbors.
Validation· The method is validated on numerical benchmarks with known objective functions and gradients.

相关性: 该论文展示了在生物电磁问题中考虑参数相关性的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的材料参数不确定性分析。
边界: This paper focuses on transcranial magnetic stimulation and electric field uncertainty, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant mechanics or structural optimization.
动机· 经颅磁刺激中组织电导率相关性对电场不确定性的影响不可忽略。

Motivation· The impact of statistical correlation between tissue conductivities on the uncertainty of induced electric fields in transcranial magnetic stimulation is significant and must be accounted for.
Method· A fast model order reduction approach is extended to handle correlated random parameters for efficient uncertainty quantification.
Result· Numerical results demonstrate that correlations between grey and white matter conductivities substantially affect the probability density function of the induced electric field.
Validation· Validation is performed through simulation on a realistic head model.

Motivation· To investigate whether varus/valgus positioning of short-stemmed hip prostheses influences periprosthetic bone mineral density changes indicative of stress shielding.

Validation· Clinical DEXA-based BMD measurements in patient cohorts.

相关性: 该论文直接评估了短柄假体在不同内翻/外翻位置下对股骨近端应力遮挡的影响，但仅使用DEXA测量BMD，缺乏有限元分析或接触力学建模。
边界: This paper does not include finite element analysis, contact mechanics, or micromotion quantification; it relies solely on clinical DEXA scans and radiographic measurements.
动机· 分析短柄假体内翻/外翻位置对股骨近端应力遮挡的影响
方法· 对75例患者进行DEXA扫描和X线评估，比较Nanos和Metha假体在不同位置下的BMD变化
结果· 假体位置对近端BMD无临床显著影响，但Gruen区1、2、6、7有显著BMD变化

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate whether varus/valgus positioning of short-stem hip prostheses influences periprosthetic bone mineral density and stress shielding in the proximal femur.
Method· DEXA scans and radiographic measurements were performed on 75 patients (Nanos or Metha stems) immediately, 97 days, and 381 days post-THA, with linear regression analysis of BMD changes in Gruen zones.
Result· No clinically relevant effect of varus/valgus stem alignment on proximal BMD was found, though significant BMD changes were observed in Gruen zones 1, 2, 6, and 7.
Validation· Clinical DEXA and radiographic follow-up in a patient cohort.

Method· Nano-structured tantalum films were deposited on sand-blasted, large grit, acid-etched titanium substrates via magnetron sputtering, creating hierarchical micro-/nano-structured surfaces.

Motivation· To assess long-term survivorship and identify risk factors for failure of compressive osseointegration fixation in lower extremity reconstructions.

边界: No biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no FEA, no implant design.
动机· 比较不同手术入路对髋臼杯放置精度的影响。
方法· 回顾性比较325例全髋置换术后髋臼杯倾角和前倾角。
结果· 仰卧位前入路比经臀入路放置更精确，异常值更少。
验证· 基于统计形状模型的计算机辅助方法验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare the accuracy and precision of acetabular cup placement between the anterior and transgluteal approaches in total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective comparative study of 325 patients (350 hips) measuring postoperative inclination and anteversion using a validated computer-assisted method based on statistical shape modeling.
Result· The anterior approach in supine position provided significantly higher precision for both inclination and anteversion compared to the transgluteal approach.
Validation· Validation was performed using a computer-assisted method that creates 3D pelvic models from 2D radiographs, with accuracy assessed against Lewinnek's safe zone.

动机· 比较Exeter创伤柄与Thompson半髋置换的临床结果
方法· 回顾性比较两组各100例患者的并发症和死亡率
结果· ETS组30天死亡率显著高于Thompson组

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare clinical outcomes of Exeter Trauma Stem versus Thompson hemiarthroplasty for femoral neck fractures.
Method· Retrospective comparison of 100 Thompson and 100 ETS cases, with an additional 100 ETS cases for validation.
Result· ETS group had significantly higher 30-day mortality and longer operative time.
Validation· Clinical retrospective study without biomechanical or FEA validation.
